estimates_population_weighted.precision_se_caveat: A stratified SE of exactly 0 arises because every sampled row in every flagged stratum was judged a lure, so p(1-p) vanishes. It is NOT a claim of infinite precision; use precision_wilson95 and false_positive_rate_upper95 instead.

kappa_reason: Cohen's kappa requires two independent raters; the annotation carries one label column. Comparing the single rater against the detector would measure the detector, not label reliability. K3's third leg remains open.

miss_location.interpretation: A miss in the detector's own `weak` band is a THRESHOLD question -- the string was seen and downgraded. A miss in `none` is a blind spot. Which band the misses fall in determines whether recall is recoverable by re-tuning or requires a new signal.

negative_class_note: lure-nodest and dest-only count as NEGATIVES: the detector's strong bar requires both a destination and a call to action, so a string with only one is correctly unflagged.

sensitivity_ambiguous_resolved.note: Each range is sorted. Resolving every unclear/blank row as a lure RAISES precision but LOWERS recall, because it adds lures to the recall denominator and most ambiguous rows fall in unflagged strata -- the two bounds run in opposite directions.

unweighted_for_comparison_only.warning: Sample rates differ ~3x between flagged and unflagged strata, so this figure describes no real population. Recorded only so the weighted/unweighted gap is visible; it must never be published.
